# ceph_role (Data Source)

Reads a Ceph Dashboard RBAC role by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceph_role" "administrator" {
  name = "administrator"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the role.
- `scopes_permissions` (Map of Set of String) Permissions keyed by security scope.
- `system` (Boolean) Whether the role is a built-in system role.
